what_is_changing.statement: Invented fixture: support revenue grew from 220000000 to 280000000 dollars while machine revenue grew from 580000000 to 620000000. Support is sold on multi-year contracts and carries a higher margin, so the recurring half of the business is growing faster than the half that depends on a customer's capital budget.

FIXT.what_it_does: Invented fixture: the company builds precision machinery and sells the support contracts that keep it running, to factories that cannot afford an unplanned stop. A customer that lost this supplier would have to re-tool its line around another maker's machine and re-qualify it, which takes the better part of a year, and would have to find spare parts in the meantime.
